# Infrastructure proposal – initial situation

## Reason and context applied for

The edition company needs a transferable infrastructure for professional autonomous teams, joint index, peer review and multi-stage publication for decades. This proposal is a well-founded working version for a decision of the responsible body; consents, financing and contracts are not yet granted.

## Scientific cooperation

Sponsored groups. Own professional responsibilities, common rules and regular integration. This requires a mandated joint editorial team. Individual text decisions lie with the experts; schema changes and common identifiers need a common mandate. Technical write access does not give scientific decision-making authority.

## Establishment, sponsorship and alternatives

Joint Academy Director. A joint Academy Director can organise operations and succession across individual workplaces. Funding, scope of service, access and exit must be made binding. Alternatives are lead university, joint Academy Director and external service. The decisive factor is comprehensible responsibility, reliable resources, representation and actually usable export rights; not the name of the service.

## Repository editing and data responsibility

Area repos plus common standards. Area repos keep together professional-related work; a standard repo connects schema, IDs and rules. Version dependencies are recorded in the band manifest. Hybrid with clear responsibilities. TEI and scripts are maintained in Git; the common index here exemplary in a database. Reproducible snapshots connect both. Each data type has exactly one crucial care location. For the XML path eXist-db is tested with TEI Publisher on a test corpus; BaseX is an alternative for XML queries and applications. Editorial needs, output and operation decide on the choice.

## Longevity and method change

New rules apply only to future volumes. Smaller direct conversion; differences between volumes must be explained and taken into account when using them across the board. A band manifest connects data, schema, ZXq1 and output path. Database levels, software dependencies and context are actually assured and reconstruction as well as host changes regularly tested. An open source license alone does not receive a service.

## Openness, re-use and publishing

The approval is unexplained. Public publication is not yet a confirmed next step. Clear contract, third-party material, jurisdiction and editorial approval. Openness is planned according to objects: findable metadata and IDs, understandable access conditions, released TEI data and documented interfaces. A comment, a digitalisat and the set publishing PDF may have other conditions. Concrete deadlines and licenses remain to be agreed.

## Independence and exit

TEI/XML, documented data models, available transformations and complete exports are intended to enable the changeover. Independent administrative accounts, several responsible persons and clarified carriers reduce dependencies. A neutral export and a fresh rebuilding must work practically; a mere contract claim is not sufficient as proof.

## Assessment and production quality

Joint review rules connect the band editors. Test bench, confidential back channel and decision on re-assessment are defined. Reviewers:Inside, exactly assigned PDF/HTML check prints and a protected back channel receive. Publisher corrections are returned to the relevant data in a controlled manner; book and digital revisions get comprehensible relationships.

## Fair process control

A new analysis will be introduced after years. Precise improvements are possible; employees and former parties will be visible at the same time afterwards. Before use, clarify scope, admissibility, participation and opposition. Precise Git analyses can make recurring problems and necessary personnel requirements visible. Personal insights, historical data, raw data access, objection and subsequent changes of purpose belong before use in the agreement. Admissibility must be examined concretely.

## Resources, Evidence and Decision

Scientific and technical editing, expert review, supervised operation, rights consulting, maintenance and migration budget as well as archive services are required. Before the decision: Test corpus and output sample, export/recovery test, responsibility matrix, license/contract examination and expense estimation present. Durations, costs, carrier commitments and responsible persons are still open.

## Revision of the proposal

Once again, when changing models, new publication conditions, carrier/personnel changes or extended analysis purposes decide; in addition, arrange a regular test date.The tool combination chosen here is an audit trail, not an already completed procurement.
